test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six people, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only three people sit to the right of G. Only two people sit between G and E. C sits to the immediate right of F and to the immediate left of G. H is not the immediate neighbour of E.

Who are sitting between G and E?
solution:
**Given :** Six people, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line, facing north. 

**Explanation :**

1) Only three people sit to the right of G.

2) Only two people sit between G and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a27009347dbf0cb2104f9b0a4e02d63ced055f9ba9cec28e0a211bfc207cb55.png] 

3) C sits
